title: What if you could pause time—but only for 10 seconds?

lines.text: Imagine having a magic stopwatch that could freeze the entire universe for ten seconds.
lines.caps: What if you could | *pause time | for *10 seconds?

lines.text: You might dream of dodging incoming danger or pulling harmless pranks on your friends.
lines.caps: You could dodge *danger | or pull wild | *pranks

lines.text: But real physics would make those ten seconds an absolute nightmare.
lines.caps: Real physics makes it | a terrifying | *nightmare!

lines.text: If time stopped, light particles called photons would also freeze in mid-air, rendering you completely blind.
Air molecules would lock solid, meaning you couldn't take a breath or even push your body forward.
lines.caps: Air locks *solid | so you can't even | *move!

lines.text: Sound waves wouldn't vibrate, trapping you in a suffocating, pitch-black void of absolute stillness.
When the ten seconds ticked down, you'd collapse gasping for oxygen, thrilled that time flows again.
lines.caps: You'd be thrilled | when *time starts | flowing again!
